demo.title: bruno-launch-quickstart.sh
demo.code:
cd scripts && npm install

# Step 1: build only — no BANKR_API_KEY needed, prints tx JSON, submits nothing
node launch.mjs --platform o1exchange --name "Popo" --symbol POPO --build-only --wallet-address 0xYourAddress

# Step 2: submit the printed {to,data,value,chainId} yourself (bankrbot's native onchain tools)

# Step 3: decode the result once you have a tx hash
node decode-result.mjs --platform o1exchange --name "Popo" --symbol POPO --tx-hash 0x...

# pools.fun and Pons need a free Pinata key to host the image/metadata (both steps)
export PINATA_JWT=eyJ...

setup: Install the one dependency: `cd scripts && npm install` (just viem)
No BANKR_API_KEY needed — launch.mjs --build-only only builds the transaction; bankrbot submits it with its own native onchain tools
For pools.fun or Pons only: export PINATA_JWT (free key at https://app.pinata.cloud/developers/api-keys)
